title: ApronHanger candidate app: a walkthrough from first launch to deleting an account
disclaimer: Recorded on an iPhone simulator against a test server. Hospitals, jobs and people are sample data.

chapters.title: Browse jobs without an account
chapters.subtitle: Anyone can look around before signing up

captions.text: Open the app: jobs are visible without an account
Tap a job to see its full details
Saving a job asks you to sign in
Sign in with your email and password
Back on the same job, now with your match insight

chapters.title: Create an account
chapters.subtitle: Name, mobile number, email and a password

captions.text: Choose Create Account
Enter your name, mobile number, email and password
The Terms and Privacy Policy are one tap away
A one-time code is sent to your mobile number
Enter the 6-digit code to verify the number
Account created: welcome to ApronHanger
Open the Search tab
Search by role or specialty
Or by city or state
Filters: city, job type, salary and more
Combine filters to narrow the list
The list shows only the matching jobs
The home feed shows open positions
Tap the bookmark to save a job
Open it: the details show it is saved
All saved jobs are in one list
Remove a job from the list any time

chapters.title: Government and international jobs
chapters.subtitle: With deadlines and links to the official source

captions.text: Government jobs and exams, with their deadlines
International openings from around the world

chapters.title: Build your profile
chapters.subtitle: A short form, saved on your phone until you finish

captions.text: Your profile lives in the Profile tab
The profile builder has 16 short steps
Your sign-in email and mobile number are fixed
Next: your medical work profile
Leave any time: your answers stay on the phone
Come back later and continue where you stopped

chapters.title: Apply with Quick Apply
chapters.subtitle: Your saved profile goes to the hospital in one tap

captions.text: Open a job: Radiology Technician
Tap Apply Now

captions.at: assertVisible: Choose one way to apply
captions.text: Apply with your saved profile or with a CV file
Answer the hospital's own questions
Application submitted
It appears in My Applications

chapters.title: When a hospital asks for documents
chapters.subtitle: The request lists exactly what is needed

captions.text: Open the Applications tab
This application has a document request
The hospital lists the documents it needs
Attach the files and upload them
Documents submitted: the hospital is notified

chapters.title: Interview invitations
chapters.subtitle: Accept, or ask for another time

captions.text: Applications are grouped by status
An interview invitation: date, venue and interviewer
Accept the interview
The hospital sees your answer at once
Or ask to reschedule, with a note for the hospital

chapters.title: Receive an offer
chapters.subtitle: Read the offer letter and accept in one tap

captions.text: The hospital sent an offer letter
Offers are shown clearly on the application
Open and read the offer letter
Accept the offer in one tap
Offer accepted

chapters.title: Stay up to date
chapters.subtitle: Updates from hospitals in the notification bell

captions.text: The bell shows unread updates from hospitals
Mark everything as read in one tap
Sign in with your email and password
You are back in the jobs feed
Sign out whenever you like

chapters.title: Forgot your password?
chapters.subtitle: Reset it with a one-time code

captions.text: Tap Forgot password
Enter your mobile number
Confirm with the one-time code
Choose a new password
Password changed: sign in again

chapters.title: Delete your account
chapters.subtitle: Permanent, and it asks for your password first

captions.text: Open Settings from your profile
Delete account: permanent, and it asks for your password
A wrong password keeps the account safe
Account deleted: your data is removed
